setup.start.title: Requirements
setup.controllers.details:
A udev rule grants access to /dev/uhid, the kernel interface for virtual HID devices.
The permission applies to the user signed in locally on this computer; other users and remote sessions remain without access.
The uhid module is then loaded automatically at every startup.
setup.firewall.details:
{firewall} is active and blocks incoming connections.
The adjustment opens Ninjoy's ports ({secure} and {plain}) and the ninjoy.local name announcement (5353/UDP).
The opening is restricted to local network addresses; external connections remain blocked.
setup.touchpad.details:
By default, Linux treats the controllers' touchpad as a mouse, moving the pointer even during games, which conflicts with Steam Input mappings.
This adjustment creates a udev rule so that libinput ignores the touchpad of Ninjoy's virtual controllers, identified by the address 02:4e:4a. Touchpads of other controllers are not affected.
If Steam Input will not be used, keeping the touchpad as a mouse may be preferable. For this reason the adjustment is optional, though recommended, and can be changed later in the Settings.
setup.ports.details:
With the standard ports (80 and 443), the controllers' address is simplified: ninjoy.local/1 instead of ninjoy.local:8080/1.
By default, Linux reserves the ports below 1024 to the administrator. The adjustment lowers this limit (net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start) to {port}, in /etc/sysctl.d. The change applies to every program on this computer, without modifying how any of them works.
